metadata.question: Were active fire counts in Punjab and Haryana lower in November 2024 than any other November from 2012 to 2023, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: FIRMS VIIRS (MODIS/006/MOD14A1 or FIRMS/VIIRS) for active fires - Actually, the best collection is "FIRMS" which has VIIRS I-Band 375m active fire product - Date: November (day 1-30) for each year 2012-2023, and November 2024 - Location: Punjab and Haryana states in India 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed - we want to count all fire detections - VIIRS data started in 2012, so we have coverage for all years - Use confidence levels if available to filter quality 3. Logic: - Count active fires in Nov 2024 - Count active fires in each November from 2012-2023 - Compare: If Nov 2024 < min(2012-2023), answer A, else B - Handle C1: If no data for any November - Handle C2: This is a point count dataset, not raster pixels - Handle C3: If counts are invalid/null ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Punjab and Haryana region (approximate bounding box) const punjabHaryana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[73.5, 28.5], [77.5, 28.5], [77.5, 32.0], [73.5, 32.0], [73.5, 28.5]] ]); // VIIRS active fire collection const firms = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS'); // Function to count fires for a given November function countNovemberFires(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 11, 1); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 11, 30); const col = firms .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(punjabHaryana); const count = col.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) { return { year: year, count: 0, hasData: false }; } // Sum all fire pixels across all images in November const fireSum = col.select(['T21']) .sum() .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: punjabHaryana, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('T21'); const fireCount = fireSum.getInfo(); return { year: year, count: fireCount || 0, hasData: count > 0 }; } console.log('Counting November fires for Punjab and Haryana...\n'); // Count fires for 2012-2023 const historicalYears = []; for (let year = 2012; year <= 2023; year++) { const result = countNovemberFires(year); historicalYears.push(result); console.log(`Nov ${year}: ${result.count} fire detections (Images: ${result.hasData ? 'Yes' : 'No'})`); } // Count fires for November 2024 const nov2024 = countNovemberFires(2024); console.log(`Nov 2024: ${nov2024.count} fire detections (Images: ${nov2024.hasData ? 'Yes' : 'No'})\n`); // Check for missing data const missingData = historicalYears.some(y => !y.hasData) || !nov2024.hasData; if (missingData) { console.log('Missing data for one or more years.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Find minimum in historical period const historicalCounts = historicalYears.map(y => y.count); const minHistorical = Math.min(...historicalCounts); const maxHistorical = Math.max(...historicalCounts); console.log(`Historical range (2012-2023): ${minHistorical} to ${maxHistorical}`); console.log(`November 2024 count: ${nov2024.count}`); // Compare if (nov2024.count < minHistorical) { console.log('\nNovember 2024 had fewer fires than any November from 2012-2023.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('\nNovember 2024 did NOT have fewer fires than all previous Novembers.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
